OpenAI reported vision and multilingual improvements and released text and image capabilities. The same page says English text and coding remained at GPT-4 Turbo level; its unreleased audio features are not counted as available improvements.

evidence_items.explanation: The announced partnership is relevant counterevidence to the suggestion that brand was OpenAI’s only advantage. It does not establish an exclusive or durable moat, and the integration was still prospective.
